purpose: Diagnosis only; production matcher unchanged. Ablations run only in an isolated LD_PRELOAD library and never publish rewrites.
cpp_flags: Original release compile command plus -g1 and -shared for the isolated matcher
units: ns; bytes are cumulative requested payload, not live/peak memory
allocation_counters: MimIR: malloc; Rust: malloc/calloc/realloc. Standard C++ containers here use malloc through operator new; raw allocation requests during search, excluding decoding and search-result destruction.
verification: All four variants preserve the complete ordered vertex mapping set of the original benchmark for every measured input. All searches Complete.
perf: Original uninstrumented binaries, perf record -e cycles:u -c 100000 (MimIR) / 20000 (portmatching naive), --call-graph dwarf,16384. Report uses cpu_core/cycles/u; CPU 2. No lost samples.
